regulations.description: Medical electrical equipment general safety requirements
Requirements for ME equipment used in home healthcare environments
Degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)

tests.description: Axial force test on rotating or movable parts of controls
tests.requirement: No unexpected change of the controlled parameter from axial force of 60 N (electrical components) or 100 N (other components) applied for 1 min

tests.description: Cord-connected HAND-HELD and foot-operated control devices
HAND-HELD control devices of ME EQUIPMENT complied with 15.3.4.1
Foot-operated control device supported actuating force of 1350 N for 1 min applied over 30 mm diameter area in NORMAL USE with no damage causing unacceptable RISK
Control device turned in all possible abnormal positions and placed on flat surface; no unacceptable RISK caused by changing control setting when accidentally placed in abnormal position
Foot-operated control device is at least IPX1 and complies with IEC 60529
ENCLOSURE of foot operated control devices containing electrical circuits is at least IPX6 and complies with IEC 60529 if liquids likely in NORMAL USE
Aluminium wires less than 16 mm² in cross-sectional area are not used
Oil container in PORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT allows for expansion and is adequately sealed to prevent loss of oil in any position
Oil containers in MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT sealed to prevent loss of oil during transport
Partially sealed oil-filled ME EQUIPMENT provided with means for checking oil level to detect leakage
MAINS SUPPLY TRANSFORMERS OF ME EQUIPMENT and transformers providing separation in accordance with 8.5

Transformers protected against overheating in event of short circuit or overload of output windings; windings did not open, no HAZARDOUS SITUATION, max winding temperatures did not exceed Table 31 values
tests.result_remark: No any transformer used in the ME equipment.

tests.description: Dielectric strength test of 8.8.3 conducted on transformer after short circuit and overload tests
Transformer output winding short circuited; test continued until protective device operated or THERMAL STABILITY achieved
Multiple overload tests conducted on windings with more than one protective device to evaluate worst-case NORMAL USE loading and protection

Transformers operating above 1 kHz tested per clause 8.8.3; windings with adequate insulation to prevent internal short-circuits; dielectric strength tests with no breakdown or detectable deterioration

Transformers forming MEANS OF PROTECTION as required by 8.5: displacement prevention of end turns, protective earth screens with insulated overlap ≥3 mm, exit of wires with double sleeving (2 MOPs, wall thickness ≥0.3 mm extending 20 mm from windings), insulation between primary and secondary complies with 8.8.2

requirements.description: Aluminium wires less than 16 mm² in cross-sectional area shall not be used in ME equipment

sub_requirements: Means provided to prevent displacement of end turns beyond the inter-winding insulation
Protective earth screens with a single turn have insulated overlap not less than 3 mm and width at least equal to axial winding length of primary side
Exit of wires from internal windings of toroid transformers protected with double sleeving providing 2 MOPs and total wall thickness of 0.3 mm extending 20 mm from the windings
Insulation between primary and secondary windings complies with 8.8.2
